question: List the full names and hometowns (city, county, state) of all members who hold the position 'Vice President' and have either generated income over $40 or incurred at least one expense.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036, z.XCL_045, z.XCL_046, z.XCL_047
FROM member AS m
JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.XCL_041 = z.XCL_043
WHERE m.XCL_038 = 'Vice President'
  AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM income AS i WHERE i.XCL_029 = m.XCL_034 AND i.XCL_026 > 40)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense AS e WHERE e.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034)
  )
